data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred is adverse prior year development relating to certain professional indemnity and international liability classes, as well as the change in Ogden discount rate; reduced by positive developments across a number of other classes.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Change in Ogden discount rate from +0.25% to -0.25% impacted reserves (included within net claims incurred as an adverse item).

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at the opening of 2019 (i.e. 31/12/2018) were GBP 1192.3m. The gross claims development on prior years is effectively flat based on the reported gross claims development triangle (no material aggregate adverse or favourable movement identifiable on a gross basis). The report does however note net adverse prior-year development within Professional Indemnity and International Liability and the impact of the July 2019 Ogden discount rate change; these are reflected in net claims movements rather than a quantifiable gross prior-year strengthening in the published gross triangle.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred is adverse prior year development relating to certain professional indemnity and international liability classes, as well as the change in Ogden discount rate; reduced by positive developments across a number of other classes.

Claims experience for the year was materially worse than that in 2018, due principally to adverse large losses within the Professional Indemnity and International Liability (particularly the mining sector) classes. This, coupled with adverse attritional losses within the International Liability class, has resulted in a net ultimate loss ratio of 72.6% (2018 55.1%). This result includes the impact of a change to the Ogden discount rate from +0.25% in 2018 to -0.25%, following the announcement by Ministry of Justice in July 2019.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development on a GROSS basis could not be identified as material from the published gross claims development triangle (the diagonals indicate no net change for underwriting years up to 2017). The report does state net adverse prior-year development (after reinsurance) and notes the Ogden rate change; however no explicit gross prior-year movement figure is provided. The claims triangle was used as the primary gross source. Triangle parsing required mapping rows to underwriting years; an aggregate 'X and prior' column was excluded per instructions.
